text: きみは　マサラ　タウンから　きたんだね？

structure.jp: マサラ　タウンから

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the short spoken form of のだ. It shows the speaker is working something out or looking for an explanation. きたんだ = 'so it is that you came'.

patterns.name: 〜ね
patterns.explanation: ね at the end asks the listener to agree with what was just said. きたんだね = 'you came, didn't you?'
